title: Stained glass: soft glint
prompt: One isolated illustrated object on a perfectly flat solid bright magenta background. Locked camera. Polished painted 2D storybook illustration. Preserve the exact object in the input image. 0-0.3s: rest. 0.3-1.1s: The stained glass window outline, frame and every colored pane stay completely fixed. A small soft light glint slowly passes across the glass and fades. Keep the original pane geometry and colors. No rotating window, no changing glass design. 1.1-1.4s: settle. Background remains solid magenta. No zoom, no scene, no text, no shadow on the background, no style change. Sound: silence.
method: Nondestructive source RGBA isolation and whole-cell normalization; original unchanged.
